interest: Index on a 1935 Philippine-Japan track meet in Tokyo.
overview: Docket entry (1935): Philippine athletic teams competed in a Tokyo track meet by invitation of Japan's amateur federation.

subfiles.about: A Department of State cross-reference sheet indexing Despatch No. 1363 regarding the visit and track and field competitions of the Philippine athletic team in Tokyo.
subfiles.from: Joseph C. Grew (U.S. Embassy, Tokyo, Japan)
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to Despatch 1363: Philippine athletic teams competed in a June 1935 Tokyo track meet by Japanese invitation.
